select pt.strategy, count(*) n, min(pt.created_at)::text first_at, max(pt.created_at)::text last_at,
       count(*) filter (where pt.experiment_deployment_arm_id is not null) stamped
from paper_trades pt where pt.created_at >= '2026-10-03T22:45:13Z' and pt.strategy in ('mmsell10','Fmmsell10','Fmmsell10_pt4','Gmmsell1','Rmmsell1')
group by 1 order by 1
